# telnyx Provider

Manage [Telnyx](https://telnyx.com) resources: numbers, voice, messaging, wireless, networking, storage and AI assistants.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    telnyx = {
      source = "romansworks/telnyx"
    }
  }
}

# The API key can also come from the TELNYX_API_KEY environment variable.
provider "telnyx" {
  api_key = var.telnyx_api_key
}

variable "telnyx_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Telnyx API v2 key. Can also be set with the `TELNYX_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the Telnyx API. Defaults to `https://api.telnyx.com/v2`. Can also be set with `TELNYX_BASE_URL`.
- `max_retries` (Number) How many times a rate-limited or failed idempotent request is retried. Defaults to `4`. Can also be set with `TELNYX_MAX_RETRIES`.
